entries.description: Analyze the shared, multi-source FOIA Aggregator corpus for disclosure and government-access patterns using reproducible labels and comparable completed-term periods. The corpus consumer and statistical workflow are under development.
Nonpartisan podcast player and searchable archive for shows hosted, co-hosted, or officially produced by current and former members of the U.S. Congress and U.S. presidents.
A marketplace and operating platform connecting biomedical researchers with naturally occurring animal disease cases, with veterinary review and controlled farm-identity disclosure.
Reusable, domain-neutral infrastructure for public registries, source documents, transparency workflows, statutory deadlines, search, APIs and revision history.
Reusable infrastructure for organization-scoped secure intake, case management, workflow routing, deadlines, review and administrative due process.
Reusable, domain-neutral infrastructure for compliance rules, authorization, tamper-evident audits, evidence, findings, remediation and reporting.
Multi-tenant, white-label storefronts for artists and labels to present, sell and license musical source material and creator-defined stem groups.
Creator-directed music-video production from an immutable audio master through creative specifications, storyboards, generated shots, first cuts, refinement and final rendering.

Implementation-neutral security architecture standard defining invariants, versioned profiles, component-scoped capabilities and evidence-based conformance. Independent expert review and release gates remain separate.
Federal Data Encryption Act policy application built on the Compliance, Authorization & Immutable Audit Engine, with application-specific rules, schemas and interfaces.

Secure Innovation Gateway application built on the Secure Intake & Case Workflow Engine for the National Secure Ideas Submission Act. Classified submissions require separately approved secure channels.
Public transparency platform for smart-city surveillance technologies, agencies, vendors, authorizations, procurement and evidence, built on the Civic Registry & Transparency Engine.
Invite-only executive dashboard for software projects, live GitHub PR activity, repository-owned roadmaps, security-standard evidence, deployment health and operational status.
Reusable, domain-neutral infrastructure for live competitions, performers, judges, audiences, rounds, monetization and operator controls.
Timed monologue competition application for performers and the industry, using Live Competition Engine while owning its own interface, policy and defaults.
Multi-tenant, white-label rap-battle and local-league platform using Live Competition Engine, with independently owned and branded promoter-operated leagues.
Compliance Engine application for algorithmic-system inventories, impact assessments, authorization before deployment and continuing accountability afterward.
Products and reusable components for usable end-to-end encryption across messaging, files, notes, email and developer tools, governed by the separate E2EESA standard.
Neutral audio foundation for encrypted media delivery, synchronized playback, spatial rendering, device evidence and reusable commerce, consumed by SceneSignal and Distributed Radio Engine.
Radio programming, contribution economics, creator wallets and bonus-release infrastructure built on Distributed Audio Engine and consumed by TrackZero.
Community spatial music sessions built directly on Distributed Audio Engine, with organizer controls, instrument placement, encrypted media and permit or no-permit-required evidence.
Artist-controlled streaming radio and whole-album commerce application using Distributed Radio Engine, with rewards tied to qualifying external Bluetooth-speaker playback.
Provider-agnostic music-business ingestion and analytics backend for label-scoped catalog, distribution and financial reports.
Unsealed Records' label-specific operations dashboard, consuming the separate Music Operations Engine API.
NFT release-management and minting console under development, with generic token, rights, royalty, ownership and immutable-evidence workflows. Private artwork and mainnet use remain gated.
Native desktop workspace for arranging instrumental music by measured dynamics, rhythm and perceived emotion, with audio and analysis kept on the user's computer.
Justice For All's shared public website, initiative directory, editorial experience, consent boundaries and integration shell.
Justice For All civic-records and FOIA participation platform for individual self-filed requests, private correspondence and reviewed documentary evidence.
Public-interest platform under development for understanding rights, documenting government actions, organizing firsthand accounts and finding support and paths to accountability.

Public-information and historical-research platform for The Garden's voluntary, self-governing remedy framework for nations harmed by the slave trade. Official governmental capabilities remain conditional.
Public policy website and scoped workspaces supporting The Cornerstone's worker-owned replacement-enterprise remedy, private preparation and synthetic program training.
Phillip Galinsky's 2028 campaign website and volunteer application, with issue presentations, campaign information and controlled volunteer workflows.
Live collaborative music application where fans contribute Sound Waves, move votes among them and help an artist turn an album into a new release at each show.
Reusable, candidate-neutral platform for asynchronous policy debates, intact contributions, direct questions, reciprocal answers and a permanent public record.
White-label operating software for structured, motion-based debate competitions, rulesets, participants, ballots and competition operations.
Planned thin, branded debate-competition application consuming Live Debate Engine. Development depends on the shared engine reaching its documented readiness gates.
Shared Superintelligence platform foundation with versioned APIs and reusable workspace interfaces for Superintelligence Academy and Superintelligence Command Center.
Independently deployed learning application using the version-pinned shared Superintelligence Engine and workspace UI. Courses and provider integration are separate development milestones.
Independently deployed command interface using the version-pinned shared Superintelligence Engine and workspace UI. Provider integration and production workflows remain separate milestones.
